scope: Functional local native HVF integration and descriptive performance pilot; not WAN or production mailbox qualification
stages: one guest sender to host receiver
guest A sender to guest B receiver through opaque host relay
whole_baseline: Existing prepared whole-object zstd path; same canonical encrypted framing, durability, fixtures and receiver lifetime
order: one then two; 1 MiB then 16 MiB; whole, warm, raw
qualification: Separate 4096-byte Warm sessions for one and two; all attempts retained and excluded from registered performance rows
exactness: Receiver independently regenerates fixture bytes and checks full byte equality and length after store reopen; two-guest mode then performs a keyless read-only verifier boot on retained ext4 disk
clock: Five-second pairwise clock profile with conservative expiry; record guest ready UTC and host console arrival UTC
bytes: Count canonical encrypted envelopes plus frame prefixes and readiness, in both directions. Two guest physical total is both vsock hops. Excludes virtio headers/control/credits and boot assets
cpu: Endpoint operation CPU, separate host relay CPU and worker/VMM lifecycle CPU; never sum guest CPU with enclosing worker CPU
elapsed: Sender encode through authenticated publication reply; separate setup and full lifecycle including boot and verification
acceptance: All registered cases exact, all directional counters reconcile, no failed transfer mislabeled as published, two-guest persisted bytes verified after reboot. Record losses and setup costs; n=1 does not support latency distribution or statistical acceptance claims
failure_rule: Keep failed attempts with source/binary identity and explicit cause. Fix source only with focused reproduction; do not silently replace or pool failed runs
storage: Use public/synthetic fixtures, credential bootstrap remains in memory/private pipes. Keep bounded receipts; remove only owned disks/caches after success and exact reboot readback
